Its just below South end circle metro station( Vijayacollege side) Visited many times for just eating food.Food is really nice❤️,service also good .Tried Egg chilli,prawns pepper fry,ghee rice ,peanut masala ,biriyani ,kebab .Prawns pepper fry highly recommended.In restaurant menu ,price of food is not mentioned but its affordable.

I had a great time at this place! It's perfect for hanging out with friends and family. The atmosphere is lovely and peaceful. The food is delicious, they deserve recognition for it! However, the service was a bit slow. They have a free 8ball table for visitors to enjoy, which is a nice bonus. I'll definitely be coming back again!
